bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (shell-internal player, demux, decoders, mixer), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a working media stack (MP4/WebM demux, VA-API/ffmpeg video decode, AAC/MP3 audio, ALSA output, A/V sync, ID3/ilst tags), but it is inside the shell and Music app, not an SDK API. Nothing exists for compositions, video effects, export or writing media.

features.note: Demux and tag reading exist (MP4, WebM, ID3, ilst) but are shell-internal; no asset or track object for apps
Reading samples is internal to the player; no writer, no export, no frame-grab API
File type identification exists; no captions or subtitle model

Wave 4 (w4-avfoundation-playback-editing, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Decode only, no encoder settings
Sample format conversion exists internally; no settings dictionary
Play, pause, seek, buffering and A/V sync work, but only through the shell (Deildu, Files video); apps get no SDK player. No looper, interstitials or rate control
VA-API hardware decode with libavcodec fallback; no frame-output API for apps
audiod and mixer own output and routing; no app-facing session API
Music integrates with the shell; widgets::player draws the mini player (docs/bifrost-ui.md)
Progressive streaming to a growing file for playback; no HLS download tasks or storage policy
HTTP sources and MSE demux exist; no HLS, AirPlay or DRM
Only an internal MSE feed for the browser; no app renderer or synchronizer
Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No composition model
MP4 parsing only, no movie editing

Wave 4 (w4-avfoundation-playback-editing, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No transitions, custom compositor or layer-animation tool

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. A system mixer exists; no per-track volume ramps over an asset

gaps: No SDK media player for apps (everything is in the shell crate)
No asset/track model or sample reader for apps
No composition, video composition or audio mix editing
No writer or export session; no encoder
No HLS, offline download management, AirPlay or FairPlay
No sample buffer renderers or synchronizer
